xs.$description: The fixed height of a data row at this size step. Rows are drawn a window at a time when a table is long, which needs every row's height known without measuring it, so the height is a token rather than the sum of padding and line height; a cell is one line and cut with an ellipsis. Each is just taller than the `IconButton` of the same size, the tallest control a row holds (a row's menu button), so a row never grows past it; never below 1.5rem (WCAG 2.5.8).
